summary.text: Brandon Elefante represents Senate District 16 in the Hawaii State Senate, to which he was elected in 2022 and re-elected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Elefante served on the Honolulu City Council from 2014 to 2022, and from 2011 to 2014 was a legislative aide to Councilmember Breene Harimoto.

Born in ʻAiea, Elefante graduated from ʻAiea High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Saint Mary's College of California and a Master of Business Administration from Chaminade University in 2011, and taught at Damien Memorial School.
